object.description: Through the MCP server, edit an object, write secrets.env at the repository root and exports/out.txt, and call commit_changes without paths. Separately, change objects in two documents and write notes.txt; delete a whole document folder; rename a document folder. Commit without paths each time. Expected: the commit holds each changed document file, the deletions of the deleted or renamed folder's files, and the renamed folder's files; no file outside document folders is committed; the latest commit's document folders are known even when the folder is gone from the working copy.
